items.exampleEn: The little girl reads fluently for her age.
items.exampleZh: 那個小女孩以她的年紀來說，讀得很流利。

items.exampleEn: The letter came back because the addressee had moved.
items.exampleZh: 那封信被退回了，因為收件人已經搬家了。

items.exampleEn: My webcam isn't working, so you can't see me.
items.exampleZh: 我的網路攝影機壞了，所以你看不到我。

items.exampleEn: The advert says the shoes are half price.
This old game came on a CD-ROM.
items.exampleZh: 這個舊遊戲是用光碟發行的。

items.exampleEn: The two old friends finally saw each other face to face.
items.exampleZh: 兩個老朋友終於當面見到了彼此。

items.exampleEn: We had a face-to-face meeting with the manager.
items.exampleZh: 我們和經理開了一場面對面的會議。

items.exampleEn: Check the message board for news about the trip.
items.exampleZh: 留意留言板上關於旅行的消息。

items.sentenceEn: My webcam takes very clear pictures.
items.sentenceZh: 我的網路攝影機拍得很清楚。

items.audioEn: I saw your advert on the message board, and I'd like to buy your old bike.
items.audioZh: 我在留言板上看到你的廣告，我想買你的舊腳踏車。
options: To put an advert on the board.
To pay for the used bike.

items.sentenceEn: Let's meet face to face next week.
items.sentenceZh: 我們下週當面見個面吧。

items.stemEn: I put a note on the ____ asking if anyone had found my cat.
items.stemZh: 我在留言板上貼了一張紙條，問有沒有人看到我的貓。

items.stemEn: After living abroad for ten years, he speaks the language ____.
items.stemZh: 在國外住了十年後，他能流利地說那種語言。

items.passageEn: My uncle loves trying new technology. Last month, he bought a webcam so that he could talk with my cousin, who lives abroad. He would rather meet face to face, but my cousin lives too far away. Now they have video chats every Sunday. My uncle also keeps an old CD-ROM full of family photos. He likes to read the message board at the library, too. Yesterday he saw an advert there for a cooking class. He wrote a letter to sign up, but he forgot to write the name of the addressee on the envelope! Still, he now writes emails to my cousin quite fluently in English.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔很喜歡嘗試新科技。上個月，他買了一台網路攝影機，好跟住在國外的表親聊天。他其實比較想當面見面，但表親住得太遠了。現在他們每週日都會視訊聊天。叔叔還留著一張存滿家庭照片的舊光碟。他也喜歡看圖書館的留言板。昨天他在那裡看到一則烹飪課的廣告。他寫了一封信報名，卻忘了在信封上寫收件人的名字！不過，他現在已經能用英文相當流利地寫電子郵件給表親了。

questions.questionZh: 叔叔為什麼買網路攝影機？
options: 為了和住國外的表親視訊
在信封上貼足夠的郵票
把報名費一起放進信封

items.promptZh: 線上課程無法取代面對面的教學。
referenceEn: Online classes can't replace face-to-face teaching.
Face-to-face teaching can't be replaced by online classes.
rubricZh: face-to-face 表示「面對面的」，放在名詞前，例如 face-to-face teaching 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 公司在公告欄上公布了新的假期。
referenceEn: The company posted the new holiday dates on the message board.
The new holidays were put up on the company message board.
rubricZh: 用 message board 表示「公告欄；留言板」（寫 notice board、bulletin board 也正確）
「公布」可寫，例如 posted、put up 等
